open-datum VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: open-datum state COMMAND

Create a registry on the proved design and fold into it

A registry of open datum on the proved design is made by spending a seed
output of your wallet: one state output that holds the registry's token and
the root of its keys, and one configuration record that fixes the registry's
five parameters for its life. Registrations are booked with the registration
commands and folded into the registry here by whichever wallet runs the fold,
from the chain alone.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  create   Create a registry              
  fold     Fold the registrations you name
